description: This file is a test script for benchmarking CLI startup performance and comparing current results against a baseline fixture. It uses Node.js modules and custom argument parsing utilities to run benchmarks, read results from JSON files, and report regressions in duration and memory consumption.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric millisecond value into a string with one decimal place followed by 'ms'.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a numeric megabyte value into a string with one decimal place followed by 'MB'.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Determines the path to the current benchmark report, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Creates a map of report cases indexed by their ID for easy comparison.
